name: DecodeBase64
description: Decode base64 content of any message and copy the decoded content.
summary: "Decode Base64" and "Copy Decoded" in a message's menu

settings.label: Click method
settings.description: Change the button to decode base64 content of any message.

choices.label: Left Click to decode the base64 content.
Right click to decode the base64 content.

notes: A message's right-click menu gets "Decode Base64" and "Copy Decoded". Like upstream, every run of four or more Base64 characters (with optional = padding) is decoded, and the ones that make valid UTF-8 text are kept. Decode Base64 shows them in a "Decoded Base64 Content" window, each in a code box with Copy ("Decoded content copied to clipboard!"); Copy Decoded copies them, one per line. A message with nothing to decode says "No Base64 content found in this message.". The click method setting puts the action it calls the left-click one first in the menu.
gaps: Qord has no plugin buttons on a message's hover bar yet, so the actions are in the right-click menu instead of a button that left- and right-clicks.
Copy Decoded copies all decoded parts, one per line; upstream copies each in turn, so only the last stays on the clipboard.
Non-ASCII text decodes properly as UTF-8; upstream shows it byte by byte.
